question: The position vector of a point $P$ is $2\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}$. Find the unit vector making the same angle with each co-ordinate axis as $\vec{OP}$, but in the opposite direction.
explanation:
The required unit vector is $-\frac{1}{|\vec{OP}|}(2\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 5\hat{k})$

$|\vec{OP}| = \sqrt{4+9+25} = \sqrt{38}$

So unit vector $= -\frac{1}{\sqrt{38}}\left(2\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}\right)$.
